prompt.text: We want a reallocation feature that allows users to see how a change could impact their budget and goals. A user should be able to specify a category to reduce spending, the amount of the reduction, and a savings goal or obligation to redirect that amount. The projection should show the old and new target in the reduced category, old and new allocation to the goal/obligation, and old with updated goal progress percentage.

events.text: We want a reallocation feature that allows users to see how a change could impact their budget and goals. A user should be able to specify a category to reduce spending, the amount of the reduction, and a savings goal or obligation to redirect that amount. The projection should show the old and new target in the reduced category, old and new allocation to the goal/obligation, and old with updated goal progress percentage.

This is a genuinely new cross-cutting feature (spans category budgets and savings goals), so let me pin down two things before planning: whether this should just be a read-only "what-if" preview or also let you commit to it, and where it should live in the app.

questions.question: Should this reallocation tool be a read-only preview, or also let the user actually apply it?

options.label: Preview-only (Recommended)
options.description: Shows the three projected numbers (new remaining, new goal allocation, new progress %) without changing any data. If the user likes what they see, they'd still go log it manually via the existing Categories/Savings Goals tabs.

options.label: Preview + an "Apply" button
options.description: Same preview, plus a button that actually records a real contribution to the goal for the redirected amount — reusing the existing "allocate leftover to goal" logic (and its existing validation) under the hood. The category's actual spend itself is never edited, since past transactions are a factual record; only the goal side becomes real.

questions.question: Where should this reallocation tool live in the app?

options.label: A new dedicated tab (Recommended)
options.description: Its own tab, since the tool spans a category and a savings goal and doesn't naturally belong to either existing tab.

options.label: New section on the Savings Goals tab
options.description: Alongside the existing "Allocate leftover to goal" form, since it's fundamentally about funding a goal.

options.label: New section on the Month Summary tab
options.description: Alongside the other budget-analysis content (charts, priority lists) that already lives there.
